📖 How to use

  1. Ride an all-out 20-minute effort and note your average power in watts.
  2. Enter that average power.
  3. Your FTP is estimated at 95% of the 20-minute power.
  4. Read the 7 power training zones in watts.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why multiply by 0.95?

Almost nobody can hold 20-minute power for a full hour. The 0.95 factor converts a 20-minute test to an estimated one-hour threshold power.

What are the 7 zones?

The classic Coggan power zones: recovery, endurance, tempo, threshold, VO2max, anaerobic, and neuromuscular, as percentages of FTP.

Should I retest often?

Every 6-10 weeks, or when training feels systematically too easy or too hard. FTP changes with fitness.
